items.title: Finding points of fibre dimension r after a surjective base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 16 行陈述（20 行证明）、满态射基变换下 dim r 点的存在与成对粘合：part (1) 一句具名外章引理归约（合法引用步骤）；part (2) 纤维积取点引理 + 整闭子概形基变换 generic 点 + 特化强制双投影 + trdeg 等式收尾。2 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-coequalizer-dim-r (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 791-806

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Part (1) is the cited Morphisms lemma on dimensions of fibres after base change. For part (2) the two points sit over a common point of the fibre product X'' = X' x_X X' by the cited Descent lemma; with Z the integral closed subscheme of the fibre whose generic point is x, each x'_i is a generic point of an irreducible component of the corresponding base change of Z, and the generic point of the irreducible component of the further base change containing x'' specializes to x'', forcing both projections to map to x'_i, while its transcendence degree equals r as a generic point of a base change of Z (source lines 808-827)
